ucaraprasrava: nāglānā udaka uccāraprasrāvaṃ kheṭaṃ siṅghāṇakaṃ vāntaṃ viriktaṃ cchorayiṣyāmi
nāglānāḥ saharitapṛthivīpradeśe uccāraprasrāvaṃ kheṭaṃ siṃghāṇakaṃ vāntaṃ viriktaṃ cchorayiṣyāmaḥ
ucatarake: na nīcatarake niṣaṇṇā uccatarake āsane niṣaṇnāyāglānāya dharmaṃ deśayiṣyāmaḥ (na nīcastarake āsana uccatarake āsane niṣaṇnāyāglānāya dharmaṃ deśayiṣyāmaḥ)
